title: int macos app-test's printed summary counts only XCTest, so a Swift Testing suite's results never reach it
body:
## What

`bin/int macos app-test` prints a summary that counts only XCTest. A Swift Testing suite's results never reach it. ic measured this on 2026-10-22 in issue 0607's worktree, where the app now carries both frameworks:

- The printed summary said "Executed 35 tests". That is the four XCTest classes alone.
- The run's result bundle, read with `xcrun xcresulttool get test-results summary`, gave 58 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, and every suite passed. That includes the three Swift Testing suites "Masthead", "Version row" and "intentd flyout".

A failure is never misreported, because xcodebuild's exit code covers both frameworks. But the summary a reader judges a run by under-reports what ran, and a judge reading "35" cannot tell that 23 tests were outside the count.

## Expected

app-test's summary comes from the result bundle, so it counts every framework the run executed and names each suite's verdict. A test that exists only in Swift Testing appears in the count, and in the failures when it fails.

Found by ic in 0607's early app-test window. Filed by vc.

CLOSED 2026-10-22. Fixed by e76f159d4: dc's bank `refs/bank/dc/0620-0621/fix`, blob ffbde118bfbc, landed at its judged patch-id 4d6bc79a72c3. `int macos app-test` now writes a result bundle (`-resultBundlePath`) and prints its summary from `xcresulttool`: the totals, each suite's verdict with its test count, and each failure with its message, for XCTest and Swift Testing alike. xcodebuild's exit status stays the verdict, and `jq` is required and checked in `app-doctor`'s preflight. The XCTest-only "Executed N tests" read is gone. In vc's window of 2026-10-22, 21:23:11Z to 21:23:37Z, the three summary arms failed on the base and passed on the fix, and one real `app-test` on the fix exited 0 with "Passed: 58 tests, 58 passed, 0 failed": the XCTest suites HealthTests, LogTests, LoginShellTests and ProjectServiceTests make 35, and the Swift Testing suites "intentd flyout", "Masthead" and "Version row" make 23. It changes development tooling only, so no release carries it.
